title: tritoniopsis antholyza
intro: Tritoniopsis antholyza, commonly known as the King lily, is a flowering plant species in the genus Tritoniopsis. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce pain, fever, and other symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Tritoniopsis antholyza include acting as an expectorant, analgesic, and antiseptic, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
